newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Dazhong buys taxi fleet.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Dazhong buys taxi fleet.

text.p: Shanghai Dazhong Taxi Co Ltd has purchased Pudong Lihua Taxi Co for 18.1 million yuan ($2.18 million), the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
Dazhong bought Pudong Lihua, which has a fleet of 64 taxis, at an auction on Monday at the Shanghai Enterprise Exchange, it said.
The newspaper said that taxi companies have found it increasingly difficult to gain approval to expand their fleets. As a result, they have looked to buying smaller companies to expand business.
Dazhong's shares were suspended from trading on Tuesday as the announcement was made, in accordance with exchange rules.
